tbesh_html:
1) band, binding
1a) cords, bands, thongs (metaphorical of slavery)
1b) bunch of hyssop
1c) band of men, troops
1d) vault (of the heavens), firmament (binding earth to the heavens)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a band, bundle, knot, or arch
strongs_1890.derivation: feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to bind);
